raw: [name="Cassia"]Once free of worry over survival, people will begin to consider 'value.' We pray that our thoughts, our deeds, even our very existence will have value.

content: Once free of worry over survival, people will begin to consider 'value.' We pray that our thoughts, our deeds, even our very existence will have value.

content: Every one of Ægir's systems is designed around unearthing that value within people.

raw: [name="Cassia"]However, value is fragile. You need only look at it from another angle, and the mighty will become the tiny. The hideous, the beautiful.

content: However, value is fragile. You need only look at it from another angle, and the mighty will become the tiny. The hideous, the beautiful.
